programme.title: REPLAY: 2019 Rose Bowl Ohio State vs Washington
programme.desc: Ohio State defeated Washington 28-23 in the 2019 Rose Bowl, holding off a furious Huskies' fourth-quarter comeback to seal the win. Quarterback Dwayne Haskins threw for three first-half touchdowns in Urban Meyer's final game as the Buckeyes' head coach, who retired after the victory.

programme.title: REPLAY: 2020 Rose Bowl Oregon vs Wisconsin
programme.desc: Oregon defeated Wisconsin 28-27 in a tight 2020 Rose Bowl game marked by six lead changes and key turnovers. Oregon quarterback Justin Herbert scored three rushing touchdowns, including the game-winner, while the Ducks defense forced four turnovers to secure the victory.

programme.title: REPLAY: 2022 Rose Bowl Ohio State vs Utah
programme.desc: Ohio State defeated Utah 48-45 in a high-scoring thriller at the 2022 Rose Bowl, sealing the win with a field goal in the final seconds. Buckeyes wide receiver Jaxon Smith-Njigba had a record-setting performance, with 347 receiving yards and three touchdowns, to lead the second-half comeback.

programme.title: REPLAY: 2023 Rose Bowl Utah vs Penn State
programme.desc: Penn State defeated Utah 35-21 in the 2023 Rose Bowl, pulling away in the second half with two explosive touchdowns of over 80 yards. The Nittany Lions' victory was secured after Utah quarterback Cameron Rising left the game with an injury in the third quarter, stifling the Utes' offense.

programme.title: CFP 1st Round Recap, G6 Outrage, ND to Play BYU, Michigan Coaching Latest
programme.desc: Sports Illustrated’s Pat Forde and Bryan Fischer are joined by former longtime College Gameday reporter Gene Wojciechowski to discuss the latest in College Football. The guys start off by rating the 1st round of the College Football Playoff and breaking down who the biggest winners and losers were. They also give their opinions on Tulane and JMU and whether the outrage surrounding their performances has become too much. Following that,they get into the CFP Quarterfinals matchups,discussing the best storyline and the underdog with the best chance to advance to semifinals. They wrap things up with breaking news surrounding Notre Dame as the Fighting Irish schedule BYU for the next two seasons,discussing the latest in the Michigan Football Coaching search and taking a look at some of the best Non-CFP Bowl Games coming up over the next couple of weeks.
